title: British Open winner Ryan Fox arrives back in New Zealand, hankering for sleep and a pie
desc: Ryan Fox arrived back in New Zealand on Friday after carrying the British Open championship -winner's claret jug from one side of the world to the other, hankering for some sleep and a gourmet pie. Fox was embraced at Auckland airport by his father, former All Blacks rugby player Grant Fox, as he arrived with his wife Anneke and two children. Fox birdied the final hole at Royal Birkdale last Sunday for his first major win.

title: Sony to reopen iconic LA theater Cinerama Dome after 6 years
desc: Renovations are set to begin in August on the Dome, which will be operated by Alamo Drafthouse Cinema, and run through early 2028.

title: Generative AI use in Japan doubles to 59% in FY 2025: gov't white paper
desc: The percentage of people in Japan who had used generative artificial intelligence roughly doubled from the previous year to 58.8 percent in fiscal 2025, a white paper released by the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications showed Friday.

title: More areas under Signal No. 2 as 'Kiyapo' slightly intensifies
desc: More areas in Northern Luzon were placed under Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No. 2 on Friday as Tropical Storm Kiyapo (international name: Noul) slightly intensified and moved closer to Extreme Northern Luzon.
